title: Taught analysts to work with AI in a three-part series
summary: Invited as keynote speaker by the North America analytics community, I taught prompt and context engineering in a three-part series, 82 to 101 people per part.
what_would_have_happened: Analysts outside engineering would have no structured way into the company's AI tools.
the_call: Teach non-engineers with hands-on exercises built on everyday tasks.
what_i_did: Built and taught the sessions with live exercises, and pointed analysts to the company's AI tools.
what_changed: The community's lead said my sessions were the top recommended material of the year.

quotes.text: These sessions are attended by 100-150 analysts across various organizations, and Datta's sessions have been the top recommended material this year.
quotes.role: Business Intelligence Lead, North America Analytics
